description: Format Rego source code using `opa fmt`. Returns the formatted source and a `changed` flag indicating whether the input was already canonical. When the source uses string interpolation ($"..." or $`...` syntax) and OPA v1.12.0 or v1.12.1 is detected, the tool warns about or blocks formatting due to a known OPA bug that corrupts \{ escape sequences (fixed in OPA v1.12.2).

v0Compatible.description: Format a policy written in pre-1.0 Rego as pre-1.0 Rego (`--v0-compatible`), leaving its syntax as it is. OPA 1.x otherwise refuses it. To convert it to Rego v1 instead, use `rego_migrate_v1`.

name: rego_format
title: Format Rego
